install_startup.recipe_modification_note: No Dockerfile/compose file in-repo for a plain local run (the project documents Docker via its own website, not the repo). Used the project's official prebuilt image (mintplexlabs/anythingllm) directly - single container, SQLite storage on a named volume. No other changes needed; booted and rendered cleanly on the first attempt.
